# Getting Started

Welcome to my application. This app implements simple GUI for yt-dlp. This app assumes you are using Windows as well as having yt-dlp and FFmpeg on your PATH (regardless of OS)
The latest version is compiled with JDK 21.0.1, so you should have a JDK (NOT JRE) version matching or newer version. 
To download, head to releases or [![click here](https://img.shields.io/badge/click_-_here-blue)](https://github.com/NathiNugget/yt-dlp_GUI/releases/download/1.2/yt-dlp_GUI.jar) to download the latest release
